sources.title: GitHub - microsoft/SpeechT5: Unified-Modal Speech-Text Pre-Training for Spoken Language Processing · GitHub
sources.snippet: The SpeechT5 framework consists of a shared encoder-decoder network and six modal-specific (speech/text) pre/post-nets. After preprocessing the input speech/text through the pre-nets, the shared encoder-decoder network models the sequence-to-sequence transformation, and then the post-nets generate the output in the speech/text modality based on the output of the decoder.

sources.snippet: SpeechT5 TTS's top strength is: Multi-task speech model: TTS, ASR, and voice conversion in one model. VITS LJSpeech's top strength is: High-quality single-speaker English TTS (LJSpeech voice).
